user.title: Printer Panel
user.description: A Printer page in the sidebar for a Creality printer set up with the Creality integration: the live camera, the print, the temperatures, the CFS colours, speed and fans, the light, and Pause, Resume and Stop.

data_description.notify: Notify services: a phone with the Home Assistant app is notify.mobile_app_<phone>.
data_description.events: The notification shows a picture of the print; tapping it opens the Printer page.

abort.no_printer: No printer found. Set the printer up with the Creality integration (ha_creality_ws) first.
abort.already_configured: That printer already has a Printer page.

options.error: A print stops with an error

line_beyond.message: The print has {lines} lines, so there is no line {line}.

line_passed.message: Line {line} is already printed: the printer is at line {at}.

moonraker_no_host.message: The Creality integration has no address for this printer.

moonraker_unreachable.message: Could not reach the printer's Moonraker: {detail}

moonraker_gone.message: The printer's Moonraker dropped the connection: {detail}
